_comment: Codex hooks (Claude-compatible event and output shape; needs `[features] codex_hooks = true` in ~/.codex/config.toml). SessionStart prints the orientation; Stop runs the handoff gate and returns {"decision":"block","reason":...} until the checkout is clean, pushed, and its register or handoff is updated. The notify wrapper in ~/.codex/config.toml (scripts/handoff/codex-notify.mjs) records the same gate after every turn regardless of this file. Both scripts live under .claude/hooks/ because they are provider-neutral Node scripts that read the same stdin payload.
